'''House Noramaga''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Kandor]].

[[Brys Noramaga]], former [[Prince Consort]] to Queen [[Ethenielle Kirukon Materasu]], was born into this House, although it is noted that he took his wife's name as [[House Materasu]] was a greater House. He also had two sisters who were born into this House, but were married by {{ne|979}}.{{ref/book|0|25}} 

Prince [[Kaisel Noramaga]] is their grandson.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Kaisel Noramaga}}
